name: Race condition
signals: same resource can be used twice
state check and state change are separate
safe_tests: use only test accounts and test resources
start with 2-3 requests, never a flood
measure one invariant before and after
stop if the service degrades or a real resource is affected
confirm: controlled parallel requests violate a stated invariant
result is repeatable and not a display glitch
no real money or user data is involved
